title: Real-time Analytics
description: Powerful analytics and insights for your browsing data
content:
Monitor key metrics in real-time through our intuitive dashboard interface. Track productivity trends, resource usage, and collaboration patterns with customizable views.

Pro Tip

Set up custom dashboards for different team members and roles to ensure everyone has access to relevant metrics while maintaining data privacy.

Key Features

Comprehensive Dashboard

  • Real-time data visualization
  • Customizable metrics and KPIs
  • Team performance tracking
  • Resource utilization insights

Advanced Reporting

  • Automated report generation
  • Custom report scheduling
  • Export capabilities
  • Data filtering and segmentation

Analytics Features

Performance Metrics

  • Browser performance monitoring
  • Network usage tracking
  • Resource consumption analysis
  • Response time measurements

Collaboration Insights

  • Team activity tracking
  • Communication patterns
  • Resource sharing analytics
  • Productivity metrics

Getting Started

1

Dashboard Setup

Configure your analytics dashboard with the metrics most relevant to your team.

2

Data-Driven Decisions

Make informed decisions based on real-time analytics and comprehensive insights.

Team Optimization

Optimize team performance and resource allocation with detailed analytics.
